title: The corkboard
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Gully puts up a corkboard. The first thing on it: Wood's pencil rough of Gully hanging the sign, torn from the pad three weeks ago and kept without saying. The corkboard's first pin. Wood sees it and orders chowder.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY screwing a corkboard to the wall above the register. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man in an apron screwing a bare corkboard to the wall above a shack register, a thin young man on a stool, a dog

panels.composition: Gully taking a folded sheet from his apron pocket. Unfolding it. A pencil rough: Gully on the ladder hanging the sign, June 20. Torn from Wood's pad when he wasn't looking.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, close-up of a young man in an apron unfolding a creased sheet of paper with a pencil sketch of a man on a ladder hanging a shop sign
image.notes: The pencil rough of Gully hanging the sign (dw_2003-06-20). It's on the corkboard until 2027 (objects.md, Gully's corkboard).

panels.composition: One pushpin. The rough on the bare corkboard, alone. Gully stepping back. Wood looking at it, then very carefully at nothing.
